hook: It is shot for sport on the way to Africa.
caption:
It is shot for sport on the way to Africa.

The European Roller is the only bird in its genus that breeds across temperate Europe and migrates south of the Sahara each fall, hunting large beetles and grasshoppers from a perch and tumbling through the aerial display rolls in the breeding season that gave the species its name. Population on the continent has dropped by roughly thirty percent since 1980. Two pressures explain the decline. Industrial pesticide use across Europe has collapsed the populations of the large insects the roller specializes in, and during fall migration the species crosses Cyprus, Malta, and southern Italy, where BirdLife International estimates that twenty-five million birds are illegally killed every year for sport, food, or trapping. The roller's flight path runs through every one of those countries.
